prompt.default: Use my Amber Notes note "Home maintenance". When I tell you about a recurring job, add a row with log_table_row: Task, Every, Last done and Next due as yyyy-mm-dd. At the start of a month, when I ask, read the table with read_table and add what's due this month under "This month" as a checklist with append_to_note. When I say I've done one, update its Last done and Next due with edit_note and tick it with set_checklist_item. Keep model numbers and warranty dates I mention under "Appliances".

asks: Add: clean the dishwasher filter every month, last done 1 September.

args.text:
- [ ] Clean the dishwasher filter (due 1 Oct)
- [ ] Test the smoke alarms (due 5 Oct)
- [ ] Service the boiler (due 12 Oct)
- Dishwasher: Bosch SMV4HTX31E, warranty until March 2028
